Method of Attack: Exploited the Log4Shell vulnerability in an unpatched VMware Horizon server
Moved laterally to the domain controller (DC)
Implanted Ngrok reverse proxies on several hosts to maintain persistence
Added a new exclusion rule to Windows Defender to allowlist the entire C:\ drive

Fetched additional payloads such as PsExec, Mimikatz, and Ngrok
Changed the password for the local administrator account on several hosts
Discoverer: U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA)
Indicators of Compromise: ZIP archive file hosted on a remote server
